about: Joints of raven_1 in its source frame (Blender axes, metres, facing -Y, its left is +X; 0.98 m beak to tail here). Read off grid_front/side/top.jpg (grid.py -- 0.4 1000), 2026-11-10. Paired joints for the left (+X) side only; rig.py mirrors them. The wings are folded along the body: shoulder, the wrist at the folded wing's front bend, the primaries back over the tail.
